title: Proposal: working together on CLN2 disease research

sentences.text: A proposal to work together on research into CLN2 disease.
We are writing to Noah's Hope because you support families affected by CLN2 Batten disease.
We have not met yet, and we would value your guidance.
CLN2 disease is driven by a lysosomal enzyme deficiency with build-up of stored material.
The international DEM-CHILD natural history database is recruiting.
Phase 1/2 and phase 2 studies of BMN 190 have completed, and cerliponase alfa is the enzyme replacement developed for the condition.
One limit: a completed gene therapy study is linked only through a broad condition label, so its relevance to CLN2 needs checking.
We would propose a study on [research question about CLN2 disease], shaped with your community from the start.
Its design, sites and funding are still to be settled: [study details].

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to discussing this idea with us?
If so, we would like to learn how the DEM-CHILD natural history work or your community might take part, always with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
If this is of interest, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
